info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Insurance Claims Claims Deny-v4-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Denial Management API enables users to efficiently handle the denial of insurance claims. This endpoint allows authorized consumers to permanently remove specific claims marked for denial, streamlining the claims management process. Typical users include claims adjusters and administrators who need to manage the lifecycle of claims within their systems. By utilizing this API, organizations can maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to deny a specific claim by its ID. Once a claim is denied, it cannot be reinstated. Ensure that the denial reason is clearly documented as part of your workflow.

requestBody.description: Request body for denying a claim. This body should contain the necessary details required to process the denial, including any relevant identifiers and reasons for denial.

200.description: The denial request was processed successfully.
